subdivision_of_building: The propsal affects only the ground floor .
description: Alterations to the shopfront including door entry arrangement, installation of an exterior chainlink security shutter. Reinstatement of front street kerb. Change of use from a vehicle repair workshop Class B2 to Class E.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [PA01, PA03, PA06, PA10, FS01, PA20, PA05, P203, PA02, PA07, Planning Statement received 17/04/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of any use within Class E that is likely to generate elevated levels of noise, including but not limited to a gym, fitness studio, day nursery or similar use, a scheme of sound insulation and acoustic mitigation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved measures shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation or use of the premises for the relevant activity and shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access shall be permanently closed and kerbs reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement. Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to confine vehicular access to the permitted points in order to ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or highway safety along the adjacent highway.
